description: This file defines API routes for managing test run groups, including listing groups, retrieving runs by group, and queuing runs for execution. It interacts with database models, CRUD operations, and external services for executing tests and handling artifacts.

methods.name: _collect_unique_cases_for_group
methods.description: Collects distinct testcase names from runs within a specified group.

methods.name: list_run_groups
methods.description: Returns a list of run groups with aggregate info such as run count, timestamps, and testcases.

methods.name: get_runs_by_group
methods.description: Returns detailed run information for a specific group.

methods.name: _execute_test_run_internal
methods.description: Executes a test run internally, handling test file retrieval, execution, artifact storage, and status updates.

methods.name: queuestart_group_runs
methods.description: Queues all 'queued' runs within a group for execution, scheduling background tasks.
